name: ARTERIAL
content:
EXAM: Arterial Ultrasound

HISTORY:  Peripheral vascular disease.


COMPARISON:  None

TECHNIQUE:  Real-time images, Color flow Doppler and Doppler spectral analysis performed on the [] lower extremity arteries.

FINDINGS: 

There is no significant flow acceleration. There are biphasic and triphasic waveforms from the common femoral arteries through the dorsalis pedis arteries.

IMPRESSION: 

No signs of occlusive peripheral vascular
